# Six Seven

> Six Seven is a fast food and coffee brand in DHA Phase 4 Lahore, Pakistan.

Six Seven serves Mighty Zinger chicken burgers, Australian beef burgers, chicken tenders, loaded chicken fries, wraps, grilled sandwiches, fresh salads, kids meals, mini pancakes, waffles, signature drinks, iced teas, smoothies, frappes, iced coffees and hot coffees. Customers can order online for delivery or pickup from the DHA Phase 4 Lahore branch.

## Menu Highlights

- Burgers: Mighty Zinger, Mighty Double Zinger, grilled chicken burgers, Single Stack, Double Stack, Triple Stack, Mushroom Melt and Smoky Barbecue Melt.
- Chicken and sides: Golden Tenders, Cheesy Tenders, Fully Loaded Chicken Fries, Classic Fries, 6-7 Masala Fries, Saucy Fries, Cheesy Fries and Curly Fries.
- Wraps and sandwiches: Crispy Chicken Wrap, Grilled Chicken Wrap, Tikka Grilled Sandwich and Fajita Grilled Sandwich.
- Salads and kids: Grilled Chicken Salad, Creamy Russian Salad, Mini Chicken Dog, 6-Piece Chicken Nuggets and 3-Piece Kids Tenders.
- Sweets: Mini Pancakes and Waffle, each with a choice of flavour — Chocolate Drip, Oreo Crunch, Dairy Desire, KitKat Crunch or Kinder Bueno.
- Signature drinks: strawberry rush, mango burst, peach breeze, berry cola and signature refreshers.
- Iced teas: peach iced tea, strawberry iced tea and passion fruit iced tea.
- Smoothies and frappes: mango smoothie, strawberry smoothie, blackberry smoothie, mocha frappe, caramel frappe and pistachio frappe.
- Coffee: espresso, americano, latte, iced coffee and related hot or cold coffee drinks.
